Subject: Action: Month-end forecast owners — stage status & QBR packet prep

Team —

Quick one: month-end forecast lock is next Friday (2026-11-13). Finance needs a definitive stage/ownership snapshot and the QBR packet inputs by EOD Tuesday 2026-11-10 so we can fold numbers into the exec pack. Ask is simple:

- Update your owned opportunities in HubSpot with the final stage (Disco / Eval / Legal / Commit) and mark "Forecast: Commit" where appropriate.
- Fill the attached QBR_review_template.xlsx for any deals you expect to include in commit (one row per deal).
- If a deal is borderline, add a short note in the template under "Assumptions" and flag with an asterisk.

I pulled a baseline snapshot (commit_snapshot_20261104.csv) and attached a one-page checklist (stage-ownership-checklist.pdf) — these are to help you reconcile. Two specific asks:

1) Marissa — please confirm which of the West accounts you plan to move to Commit this cycle.
2) Laura — can you validate the Legal-stage timing for Fenwick? Rebecca from Fenwick is included below; Procurement may push on terms.

If we don't have an explicit "Commit" flag or a filled QBR row by EOD 11/10 we will assume the deal is Not Committed for the month and exclude it from the commit number. Finance will lock the forecast 11/13 09:00 PT.

Links: QBR folder -> https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBR-PREPARATION-2026
HubSpot snapshot -> https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/pipeline/DEAL-4982

Thanks — please reply with any blockers.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Marissa — good question. Per our current commit policy (link below), a signed commercial term sheet or executed MOU with explicit payment terms qualifies as Commit only when both: (a) legal has confirmed track changes are non-substantive AND (b) procurement has indicated pricing/terms won't change the economics materially. If Procurement is still negotiating core pricing, mark as "Commit-Pending" in the template and add a one-line rationale.

I'll touch base with Fenwick's legal lead this morning — Rebecca, can you confirm whether procurement expects further redlines on the pricing schedule?

Policy link: https://internal.redwood.ai/policies/commit-definition

-Laura
